post.description:
Set a local user's password (the user must change it at the next sign-in unless told otherwise); every
session of the user ends.

delete.description:
Sign a user out everywhere, ``docker login`` refresh tokens included (API tokens are not affected). Not for a
user holding more than the caller.

get.description: A user's sessions, newest first (``current`` marks the caller's own).

delete.description:
Remove a user's second factor (a lost device). Not one's own (turn it off on the profile page, which needs
the password and a code) and not for an account holding more than the caller.
